title: QUIZ - 54
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.concept: Multi-Step Inequalities with a Negative Coefficient
questions.learningObjective: Solve a two-step inequality that requires flipping the symbol when dividing by a negative number
questions.question: Solve for t: \( -3t + 12 \geq -9 \)
questions.explanation: Subtract 12: \(-3t \geq -21\). Divide by -3 (negative), flipping the symbol: \(t \leq 7\).
questions.hint: Isolate the variable term first, then remember to flip the inequality when dividing by a negative coefficient.

questions.concept: Recognizing When to Flip the Inequality Symbol
questions.learningObjective: Recognize that dividing by a negative number requires flipping the inequality symbol
questions.question: When solving the inequality \( -5a > 10 \) for a, what must be done to the inequality symbol?

options.label: A
options.text: It must be flipped to <, because both sides are divided by a negative number.

options.label: B
options.text: The symbol is removed entirely and replaced with an equal sign.

options.label: C
options.text: It stays the same, because only the coefficient matters, not its sign.

options.label: D
options.text: It must be flipped only if the constant is also negative.

questions.explanation: Since -5 is negative, dividing both sides of the inequality by -5 reverses its direction, changing > to <.
questions.hint: Whenever you divide or multiply an inequality by a negative number, reverse the inequality symbol.

questions.concept: Dividing by a Negative Coefficient
questions.learningObjective: Solve an inequality by dividing both sides by a negative number and flipping the symbol
questions.question: Solve for x: \( -7x > -63 \)
questions.explanation: Dividing both sides by -7 (a negative number) flips the inequality: x < -63/-7 = 9.
questions.hint: Dividing or multiplying both sides by a negative number reverses the direction of the inequality.
